en: When is a task submission created?
When does my task submission appear?
Why don't I have a submission yet?
Does enrolling create a task submission?
Is a submission created when I open a lesson?
or: enroll karile submission create hue ki
lesson open karile submission create hue ki
hi: task submission kab create hota hai
abhi mera submission kyu nahi hai
enroll karne par submission create hota hai kya
lesson open karne par submission create hota hai kya
mixed: enroll karile submission create heba ki
lesson open karile submission kebe asiba
mera submission ebe kahinki nahi achhi

answers.en: A task submission is created when the corresponding task becomes eligible and is unlocked according to the task progression rules. Simply enrolling or opening a lesson does not create a task submission.
answers.or: Corresponding task eligible hei task progression rules anusare unlock heba pare task submission create hue. Khali enroll kariba ba lesson open kariba dwara task submission create hue nahi.
answers.hi: Task submission tab create hota hai jab corresponding task eligible hokar task progression rules ke according unlock hota hai. Sirf enroll karne ya lesson open karne se task submission create nahi hota.
answers.mixed: Corresponding task eligible hei progression rules anusare unlock heba pare submission create hue. Khali enroll ba lesson open karile submission create hue nahi.

en: My submission is waiting for approval
Why has my task submission not been approved?
or: mora submission approval pain wait karuchi
hi: mera submission approval ke liye wait kar raha hai
mera task submission approve kyu nahi hua
mixed: mera submission approval pain wait karuchi

answers.en: A submitted task remains pending while it is waiting for admin review. Once the admin reviews the submission, its status can be updated according to the review result.
answers.or: Task submit kariba pare admin review kariba parjanta submission pending re rahithae. Admin review pare review result anusare status update hei pare.
answers.hi: Task submit karne ke baad admin review hone tak submission pending rehta hai. Admin review ke baad review result ke according status update ho sakta hai.
answers.mixed: Task submit kariba pare admin review kariba parjanta submission pending re rahithae. Review pare status update hei pare.

en: What happens when my submission is approved?
My task was approved, what happens next?
or: mora task approve hela pare kana haba
hi: submission approve hone par kya hota hai
mera task approve hone ke baad kya hoga
task approval ke baad kya hota hai
approved submission ka matlab kya hai
mixed: mera task approve hela pare kana hue

answers.en: An approved submission means the admin has accepted the submitted task. The next task can become available according to the task progression rules.
answers.or: Approved submission mane admin submitted task ku accept karichhanti. Task progression rules anusare next task available hei pare.
answers.hi: Approved submission ka matlab hai ki admin ne submitted task ko accept kar liya hai. Task progression rules ke according next task available ho sakta hai.
answers.mixed: Approved submission mane admin task ku accept karichhanti. Progression rules anusare next task available hei pare.

en: Can I submit after the deadline?
What can I do about an expired submission?
or: mora task submission expired hei gala
hi: mera submission expire kyu ho gaya
mera task submission expire ho gaya
deadline ke baad submit kar sakta hoon kya
expired submission ke liye kya karun
mixed: deadline pare task submit kariparibi ki
mera submission expired hei gala kana karibi

answers.en: A submission can become expired when its task deadline has passed without a valid submission. If you need an extension or believe there is an issue, contact the support team.
answers.or: Valid submission purbaru task deadline sari gale submission expired hei pare. Extension darkar thile ba problem thiba bhabile support team ku contact kara.
answers.hi: Valid submission ke bina task deadline khatam hone par submission expired ho sakta hai. Agar extension chahiye ya koi issue hai, to support team se contact karein.
answers.mixed: Valid submission purbaru deadline sari gale submission expired hei pare. Extension ba issue thile support team ku contact kara.
